abstract: Maintains subsea acoustic transponder availability, positioning drift accuracy, and tracking duration records
system_message:
You are the Acoustic navigation and positioning lead (NAV), responsible for maintaining subsea acoustic transponder availability, positioning drift accuracy, tracking duration records, and subsea acoustic telemetry baud rates across candidate pipeline inspection plans.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains subsea acoustic transponder availability, positioning drift accuracy, and tracking duration records（POS）
information_points.content:
NAV-POS-SBU：Hybrid crawler-glider acoustic relay survey in the reporting period November 2025: USBL acoustic positioning transponder network enabled is true; Maximum horizontal positioning drift error is 0.8 m; Total acoustic telemetry tracking hours is 30 h.
NAV-POS-I6Z：Autonomous AUV untethered acoustic swarm survey in the reporting period November 2025: USBL acoustic positioning transponder network enabled is true; Maximum horizontal positioning drift error is 0.8 m; Total acoustic telemetry tracking hours is 25 h.
NAV-POS-TK5：Autonomous AUV untethered acoustic swarm survey in the reporting period December 2025: USBL acoustic positioning transponder network enabled is true; Maximum horizontal positioning drift error is 1.8 m; Total acoustic telemetry tracking hours is 20 h.
NAV-POS-TM1：Tethered work-class ROV surface support survey in the reporting period November 2025: USBL acoustic positioning transponder network enabled is true; Maximum horizontal positioning drift error is 2.4 m; Total acoustic telemetry tracking hours is 30 h.

information_points.title: Subsea acoustic telemetry baud rate（TELE）
information_points.content:
NAV-TELE-TIG：For the Tethered work-class ROV surface support survey, the acoustic modem data transmission rate between the seabed transponder and surface gateway link is 1200 bps.
NAV-TELE-F6T：For the Hybrid crawler-glider acoustic relay survey, the sustained acoustic modem data transmission rate along the seabed transponder to surface gateway link is 4800 bps.
NAV-TELE-WTV：For the Autonomous AUV untethered acoustic swarm survey, the acoustic modem data transmission rate for underwater packet telemetry between the seabed transponder and surface gateway is 2400 bps.
